notes.title: Leap Of Faith 1.2 - Achievements and more fixes
notes.content:
+Added 55 obtainable Steam achievements

Fixed various bugs having to due with being shocked and the shock platforms in the rocket.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1 Fly Fix
notes.content: Fixed a problem where flies would overpopulate the bottom of Tier 1.

notes.title: Leap Of Faith Hat Contest
notes.content:
THERE MAY BE ONLY ONE WINNER. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385884/0f8d782ed4dff40e9bf9bc0312f5d33f0a2a5703.png

What do I have to do? 


 Request Access to the Leap Of Faith Playtest.
 Get to the cockpit and find Little Icarus.
 Screenshot yourself in the cockpit.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385884/058eeeb5a13a12d4bbd034786a5a2e4848d7f6c1.png

I somehow did it, what do I win? 


You get any hat of your choice added to the game for Icarus to find! 

(Some restrictions apply)
-Must be a hat that is not already in the game. 
-Must be legal to use.
-Must be appropriate for all ages.




Is there a deadline? 


Yes, the deadline for submissions is February 24th.




So what if nobody wins by the deadline? 


Then I make the missing hat a Poop.





 All submissions should be sent to steinbergeric6@gmail.com
